definition: Sector-specific public Article89 reporting, separate from confidential BEPSAction13 and general-MNE public income-tax reporting.
holding_company_warning: French law explicitly includes financial holding entities; UK guidance excludes holding companies as institutions. Do not generalise one national rule.

rules.covered_information: Names, nature and geographic location of establishments; turnover; full-time-equivalent employees.
rules.scope: Institutions as defined in the original CRR: credit institutions and investment firms, subject to CRD Article2 exclusions. Consolidated activities inside and outside the Union.

rules.covered_information: Adds profit/loss before tax, tax on profit/loss and public subsidies. Annual consolidated country reporting.
rules.scope: Same original Article89 scope; no EUR750million MNE revenue threshold. Banking-group and regulated-filer roles differ.

rules.covered_information: One-off confidential2014 profit/tax/subsidy submission to Commission, not an initial full public mandate.
Initial partial information by1July2014; full country disclosures by31December2015 and annually thereafter, for the immediately preceding accounting period.
rules.scope: UK-authorised CRR institutions. Holding companies and third-country branches are not themselves institutions; regulated subsidiaries may be. Qualifying prior group disclosures can discharge reporting with a public pointer.

rules.covered_information: Partial2013accounts/publication2014; full2014accounts/publication2015. Consolidated annex or within six months of year end.
rules.scope: Credit institutions, financial companies, mixed financial holding companies and investment firms. French holding-company scope differs from the UK.

rules.covered_information: Country reporting in annex to consolidated accounts; accounting consolidation and Bundesbank guidance define calculation.
rules.scope: Institutions underKWG26a; do not substitute EU market-country equity coverage for authorised institution eligibility.
